name: Plugin Update
author: Brett
description: Every installed plugin with the model that built it, when it was built and its version, checked against the plugin catalog on axHub. A newer version by the same model installs with one click (Update); a build by another model offers Replace, which lists the removal of the old build and the installation of the new one and swaps them in the same folder once confirmed; Rebuild with <model> parks a from-scratch rebuild on the pending list for the Build manager. Never two builds of one plugin. Nav → Plugins → Plugin Update, Settings → Plugins → Plugin Update.
